title: Mario's childhood sightings of craft

tellings.quote: I think about all the times I've ever from a boy when I've seen these things when I'm not them but their their craft.

plain: Mario Woods says he has been seeing strange craft since he was a boy. Woods is an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by aliens, and he tells this himself in a 2026 episode. He is careful to say that he saw their craft, not the beings themselves.
